seo.title: ODDference 2027 — Creativity, Business & Society | All Things ODD
seo.description: Where creative expertise meets business and society. ODDference brings creative practitioners, business leaders and decision-makers together at Tanssin talo, Helsinki, on 22–23 April 2027.

title: Where creative expertise meets business and society

concept.headline: What can business and wider society learn from creative expertise?
concept.body:
Creativity shapes what people notice, desire, remember and care about. Yet creative expertise is still too often treated as decoration, entertainment or inspiration — brought in after the important decisions have already been made.

ODDference starts from a different premise. For two days at Tanssin talo, creative practitioners bring that expertise into the same room as leaders from business and wider society — exploring what imagination, taste, cultural relevance and experimentation can teach us.

reasons.title: Why should anyone care?
reasons.body: From brands and products to cultural movements, attention alone isn't enough. Meaning, distinction and cultural understanding shape what people value and choose.

reasons.title: What makes people want to belong and participate?
reasons.body: Communities, teams and organisations thrive when people feel they belong and have a real part to play. Trust and shared experiences make that possible.

reasons.title: How do we create what doesn't yet exist?
reasons.body: When familiar answers stop working, imagination and experimentation open new paths. Creative practitioners know how to challenge assumptions and make ideas real before there's a blueprint.

partnershipCta.title: What could your organisation bring to ODDference?
partnershipCta.body: Bring an idea, expertise or a question worth exploring with the people at ODDference. We’re interested in partnerships that create something valuable for the people taking part.

faq.question: Who is ODDference for?
faq.answer:
ODDference is for people shaping the future of businesses, organisations and society. From CEOs and leaders in brand, strategy, innovation and people to influential voices in culture and the creative industries.

It's for decision-makers who recognise that the most interesting answers don't always come from within their own field.

faq.question: Why is ODDference relevant to my work?
faq.answer:
Every organisation faces questions of relevance, connection and reinvention.

How do you create something people genuinely care about? What makes people trust, participate and feel they belong? How do you challenge established thinking and find new ways forward?

ODDference explores these challenges through the perspectives and practices of people who work with creativity every day.

faq.question: What will I take back to my organisation?
faq.answer:
Fresh perspectives on familiar challenges, examples of how creative professionals approach complex questions and new connections beyond your usual professional circles.

You might discover a different way to approach your brand, lead your team or develop an idea. The value isn't a ready-made playbook, but new ways of thinking you can put to work.

faq.question: How is ODDference different from other business conferences?
faq.answer:
Most business conferences bring business experts together to discuss business challenges. ODDference takes a different approach.

We put creative practitioners at the centre of the conversation and bring them together with decision-makers from business and society.

Rather than hearing more of the same perspectives, you'll encounter people who think, create and solve problems in fundamentally different ways.

faq.question: Who will I meet?
faq.answer:
We're bringing together decision-makers from business, culture, the creative industries and wider society.

The ambition is a room where a business leader might find themselves in conversation with an artist, a cultural institution director, a designer or someone shaping public policy.

People whose paths rarely cross, but who might have more to learn from each other than they expect.

faq.question: What can I expect from the programme?
faq.answer:
ODDference 2027 is built around three themes: Relevance, Connection and Reinvention.

We'll explore them through the experiences, ideas and expertise of creative practitioners and leaders working across different fields. Expect specific questions, real experiences and perspectives that challenge conventional thinking.

The programme is still taking shape. You can explore highlights from ODDference 2026 to get a sense of the conversations we've brought to the stage before.

faq.question: Why buy a ticket before the full programme is announced?
faq.answer:
Blind Bird offers our lowest ticket price to those who want to commit early.

We understand that some participants need to see confirmed speakers and sessions before making a decision, particularly when attending through their organisation. We'll announce more of the programme as it develops, with later ticket tiers available at higher prices.

faq.question: Where and when does ODDference take place?
faq.answer:
ODDference takes place on 22–23 April 2027 at Tanssin talo (Dance House Helsinki).

Your ticket gives you access to both conference days. You can find the current ticket options and purchasing details on our ticket page. For organisational bookings or invoicing, contact hello@oddfest.co.
